theme: Vacation rental damage/turnover/cleaning marketplaces (Turno, TurnoverBnB), STR supply services (Airbnb photographer, key exchange) datasets
queries_run: gh search repos "str cleaning marketplace" --sort stars
gh search repos "vacation rental cleaning" --sort stars

candidates.name: turno-mcp
candidates.what_it_holds: Multi-tenant MCP server wrapping the Turno (formerly TurnoverBnB) v2 REST API: 49 tools covering properties, bookings, projects, cleaners, webhooks. No committed data — it is a live client that requires an authenticated Turno account/API key to pull anything (turnaround-time bookings, cleaner assignments, project status per property). AGPL-3.0, updated 10 Sep 2026, 0 stars.
candidates.why_useful: Confirms Turno exposes a documented v2 API (properties/bookings/cleaners) that could in principle be queried for turnover cadence / cleaner-marketplace activity as a nights-proxy, but there is no public dataset and no free sample; would need our own paid Turno account to pull anything, which is outside a cataloguing pass.

candidates.name: breezeway-python
candidates.what_it_holds: Python client library for Breezeway.io (a property-operations / cleaning-and-maintenance platform for STRs), handling auth and API calls. No committed data; requires a Breezeway account to retrieve anything (task/turnover schedules, inspections, supply orders per property). MIT license, updated 21 Dec 2025.
candidates.why_useful: Same pattern as turno-mcp: proves Breezeway has an API surface that could carry STR-turnover-cadence signal, but nothing here is public data — it's a bring-your-own-account client.

candidates.name: breezeway-supply-report
candidates.what_it_holds: Client-side reporting tool that reformats Breezeway vacation-rental-cleaning CSV/data exports (supply usage, task completion) into reports. Operates on a user's own exported files, not on any bundled public dataset. Updated 7 Sep 2026, 0 stars, no visible license.
candidates.why_useful: Only useful if one already has Breezeway account exports; no data shipped with the repo, so it does not by itself give us anything to pull.

candidates.name: breezeway
candidates.what_it_holds: Described only as "Breezeway operations data integration / ETL"; repo is small/unstarred with no visible README detail beyond the description and no confirmed committed data files (not independently verified beyond the search description; description text only).
candidates.why_useful: Possible ETL pattern for Breezeway ops data if it turns out to include sample exports, but unverified and most likely another account-specific integration script rather than a dataset.

candidates.name: airdna-mcp
candidates.what_it_holds: FastMCP server exposing AirDNA's STR market-data API (occupancy, ADR, RevPAR by market) as MCP tools. Requires an AirDNA Enterprise API subscription; no data bundled. Updated 15 Apr 2026.
candidates.why_useful: Adjacent to gap #2 (realised ADR/occupancy for STRs) rather than our turnover/cleaning theme proper — flagging because it surfaced in the same sweep and documents that AirDNA's API is at least programmatically reachable (paid), which is a standing target for a different scout's gap-2 work.

candidates.name: rental-averages
candidates.what_it_holds: Small MIT-licensed app that processes an AirDNA data export (CSV) into mean occupancy and ADR by market. Ships with code only, not the underlying AirDNA export itself, so no data is actually distributed. Updated Aug 2023 (stale).
candidates.why_useful: Same pattern — a processing script for AirDNA output, not a dataset; relevant only if we already had our own AirDNA pull to run it on. Marginal.

candidates.name: airdna
candidates.what_it_holds: An independent third-party API-surface profile/documentation of the AirDNA Enterprise API (market metrics, listing data, comparable sets, Rentalizer revenue estimates) by API Evangelist. Documentation only, no data files, no code that pulls data without a paid AirDNA key. Updated 13 Sep 2026 (very fresh).
candidates.why_useful: Useful as a map of what AirDNA's API can return (in case the team later gets access), but contains zero actual data and is off our assigned theme (turnover/cleaning); noted for the record only.

notes: This theme is essentially a dead end on GitHub. Exhaustive searches on 'turnoverbnb', 'turno cleaning', 'str cleaning marketplace', 'vacation rental cleaning', 'turno api', and 'breezeway' returned almost nothing but (a) unrelated Spanish-language 'turnos' (shift/appointment scheduling) apps that happen to share the substring 'turno', (b) dozens of local cleaning-business marketing websites/portfolio sites with zero data, (c) one-off coding-bootcamp clone/challenge repos literally named 'turnoverbnb' that are UI clones of the company's booking form, not data. No repo anywhere commits STR cleaning-marketplace data (turnaround times, cleaner counts, pricing, damage-claim rates) or photographer/key-exchange marketplace data (TaskRabbit-for-hosts, Vacasa/Breezeway's photography vendor networks) as an open dataset. The only real substance found was API *client* wrappers (turno-mcp, breezeway-python) for the proprietary Turno and Breezeway platforms — useful only with a paid subscription, which is out of scope for a cataloguing pass and yields no free data. A tangential 'airdna' query (relevant to gap #2, realised ADR/occupancy, not this theme) surfaced similar client/documentation repos with the same limitation: everything about AirDNA on GitHub is a scraper or API wrapper requiring a paid key, never a committed public dataset. Recommend: do not spend further scout budget on Turno/TurnoverBnB/Breezeway by name; if the team wants STR-turnover-cadence data, the more promising route is Inside Airbnb calendar-availability transitions (already held) rather than any cleaning-marketplace vendor, since none of Turno/TurnoverBnB/Breezeway/Properly publish aggregate stats or open data.
